name: ah-sheli-gibor
description: The comprehensive Hebrew production suite. 25+ output types (rewrite/pitch/speech/talking-cards/teleprompter/book-chapter/book-proposal/manuscript-edit/article-feature/op-ed/news/profile/course-material/report-executive/business/whitepaper/incident/research-paper/proposal/thesis-chapter/business-plan/rfp-response/case-study/comms/tech-doc/product-spec) × 15 variation modes (tech-general/software-engineering/cybersecurity/product-management/defense-aerospace/ai-ml-research/startup-fundraising/gen-z-creator/legal-technical/medical/biblical-rabbinic/gender-emotional/slang-cultural/bilingual/creative-lyrics) + 4 community sub-filters × 6 voice personas. 124-entry Hebrew AI source catalog with task-aware source selection. Six-stage validation + 4-axis Hebrew-labeled rubric (רלוונטיות / קוהרנטיות / עקביות / רהיטות). Unified hebrew_toolkit.py CLI invokes specialized Hebrew models on demand (DictaBERT, DictaLM-3.0, hebEMO, Legal-heBERT, BEREL, ivrit-ai Whisper, Dicta Nakdan, Helsinki-NLP MT, het5_summarization). Documents NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM production deployment.
